test_completeness.note: 17 behaviors, 0 testable-but-untested, against 7 acceptance criteria. No 'untestable' rows. The single candidate - 'uv actually resolves 3.11 at runtime' - is covered by ten real-subprocess probes recorded in the spec rather than filed as untestable: asserting it inside the F0 unit would make that unit depend on uv's interpreter-download service and on the exact patch build, i.e. a network-dependent non-deterministic assertion inside the very gate this run exists to make trustworthy.

degraded.detail: Gemini returned finish_reason=length on BOTH external reviews (iterate mode and code mode), so each was recorded degraded/unavailable and only OpenAI answered. Per the standing rule a truncated reply is not a clean pass, so it is not counted as a second opinion. The GPT reviews were acted on in full: the iterate-mode review produced the 'absence is not agreement' CI guard and corrected an overstated warm_up claim; the code-mode review produced the comment-stripping fix and the quote-agnostic escape guard. Gemini's readable fragment raised only the 15-file duplication, which the operator had already decided and which AC6/AC7 address.
